description: Sophisticated 1BD/1BA condo with sweeping Richardson Bay and hillside views.This light-filled residence features an open living/dining area with hardwood floors, built-in shelving, and a wood-burning fireplace. A sliding glass door opens to a covered view deck, creating seamless indoor-outdoor flow.  The updated kitchen is appointed with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, cherry cabinetry, and a breakfast bar. The spacious bedroom is complemented by a well-appointed bath with dual sinks, granite surfaces, and a shower over tub. In-unit stacked washer/dryer completes the home.  Ideally located near downtown Sausalito, waterfront dining, shopping, and public transportation, with easy commute access.
